Proposition
[Properties of Induced Homomorphisms] ↗ prop:induced-lie-algebra-homomorphism 1. chC:C.6

Let $G, H, K$ be Lie groups.

  1. $(Id_G)_* = Id_{\operatorname {Lie}(G)} : \operatorname {Lie}(G) \to \operatorname {Lie}(G)$.

  2. If $F_1 : G \to H$ and $F_2 : H \to K$ are Lie group homomorphisms, then

    \[ (F_2 \circ F_1)_* = (F_2)_* \circ (F_1)_* : \operatorname {Lie}(G) \to \operatorname {Lie}(K). \]

  3. Isomorphic Lie groups have isomorphic Lie algebras.
